statement: For each parent placement the exact-one profile flags choose one original shape, whose integer Y lies in its complete disjoint cell cover. Set its unique cell flag to1 and every other cell flag to0. Profile sums and Y implications hold. Every source pair clause prevents overlap of the original filled outer profiles and the stock domains place them inside the stock. Each occupied horizontal band area is at least the independently audited lower area of its selected cell. Summing their floored area units cannot exceed the floored stock capacity. Hence all63 added band inequalities are necessary, every parent source-coordinate witness extends, and no original coordinate/profile choice is fixed by the construction. Projection of any new witness satisfies the unchanged parent.
